description: Flat metadata schema for individual metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) records from bacteria isolated from soil samples across geographic locations, including binning provenance, software parameters, and genome quality metrics.

mag_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG/bin record (e.g., MAG_0001).

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the originating soil sample from which the MAG was recovered.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling location or field site.

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of sampling location above sea level in meters.

collection_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

soil_type.descr: Descriptive soil class or type, for example loam, sandy loam, clay, or field classification.

biome.descr: Biome or ecosystem classification of the sampling location, for example temperate forest, grassland, desert, or agricultural soil.

land_use.descr: Land-use category of the site, for example natural, agricultural, urban, or restored.

environmental_condition.descr: Free-text or controlled description of major site conditions relevant to microbial adaptation, for example arid, saline, acidic, or contaminated.

ph.descr: Soil pH measured at the sample site or extracted from associated soil chemistry data.

moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as a percentage (0-100).

organic_matter_percent.descr: Organic matter content of the soil as a percentage.

temperature_c.descr: Sampling-site or incubation temperature in degrees Celsius, if measured.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used to extract DNA from the soil sample.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used to generate reads, for example Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, or Oxford Nanopore.

read_type.descr: Type of sequencing reads used for assembly and binning, for example short-read, long-read, or hybrid.

assembly_software.descr: Assembler used to generate contigs/scaffolds prior to binning.

assembly_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

binning_algorithm.descr: Binning software/algorithm used to separate genomes from the metagenomic assembly, for example MetaBAT2, MaxBin2, CONCOCT, VAMB, or DAS Tool.

binning_parameters.descr: Key binning parameters used, recorded as a concise string or code-like text (e.g., minimum contig length, coverage thresholds, cluster settings).

coverage_input_type.descr: Type of abundance/coverage information used for binning, for example single-sample coverage, differential coverage across samples, or k-mer composition only.

manual_refinement.descr: Indicates whether manual curation/refinement of bins was performed after automated binning.

refinement_software.descr: Software used for manual refinement or visualization of bins, if applicable.

taxonomy_domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assigned to the MAG, expected value typically Bacteria for this dataset.

taxonomy_phylum.descr: Assigned phylum of the MAG, if available.

taxonomy_class.descr: Assigned taxonomic class of the MAG, if available.

taxonomy_order.descr: Assigned taxonomic order of the MAG, if available.

taxonomy_family.descr: Assigned taxonomic family of the MAG, if available.

taxonomy_genus.descr: Assigned taxonomic genus of the MAG, if available.

taxonomy_species.descr: Assigned species name or species-level cluster label, if available.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as a percentage, typically 0-100.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination as a percentage, typically 0-100.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or microdiversity percentage, if reported.

checkm_version.descr: Version of the genome quality assessment software used, commonly CheckM or CheckM2.

checkm_method.descr: Quality assessment method or model used, for example lineage-specific workflow or marker-gene model.

num_contigs.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds in the final MAG.

genome_size_bp.descr: Estimated total genome size of the MAG in base pairs.

n50_bp.descr: Contig N50 of the MAG in base pairs.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the largest contig in the MAG in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG as a percentage.

coding_density_percent.descr: Proportion of the genome predicted to be coding, as a percentage, if available.

num_cds.descr: Number of predicted protein-coding sequences (CDSs) in the MAG.

rRNA_16S_present.descr: Indicates whether a 16S rRNA gene was detected in the MAG.

tRNA_count.descr: Number of predicted tRNA genes in the MAG.

ambiguous_bases_percent.descr: Percentage of ambiguous bases (N characters) in the final MAG sequence.

quality_category.descr: Curated MAG quality class, for example high-quality, medium-quality, or low-quality, based on the study's chosen criteria.

dereplicated.descr: Indicates whether this MAG was included in a dereplicated genome set.

dereplication_method.descr: Method or software used for dereplication, if applicable.

cluster_id.descr: Cluster or species-level genome bin identifier used to group related MAGs, if applicable.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the MAG record, such as unusual assembly issues, contamination sources, or interpretation caveats.
